guide.summary: Helps the water hold its pH steady.
guide.biology: Buffers soak up some acid or base, so the pH changes less when either is added.
guide.rules: Adds buffer capacity that dissolves and diffuses. It does not change pH by itself: it divides the difference between base and acid, so shown pH = 7 + (base - acid) / (1 + buffer), kept between 2 and 12. Buffer 1.0 halves how far pH moves away from 7. No additional modeled reaction.
guide.example: Buffer one half of a dish of Bubbles and compare how sour each half becomes.
